verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes a versioned API reference at developers.anytype.io/docs/reference, with a version picker and changelog, backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI v2 spec that includes full schemas and error responses. It also hosts an examples section on the developer portal. However, the evidence explicitly states that no try-it console is published, so the interactive and runnable part of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console in the reference, runnable request examples within the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
